title: Hosted API Geo-Assertion Controls and Automated Evidence Pipeline
creator: Ethan Cho
description:
Problem: Customers operating in regulated jurisdictions require provable, time-bound assertions that their Hosted API traffic and persisted artifacts remained within declared geographies and were retained/disposed according to SLRs. We need an end-to-end control: an operator + tenant-facing API to declare geo-preference, enforcement at routing/storage, and a machine-readable evidence bundle generator for audits.

Scope: 1) Tenant-facing controls to assert geography preferences and soft/strict routing modes. 2) Server-side enforcement hooks (routing + storage TTL/retention metadata). 3) Evidence packager that creates signed, timestamped bundles (audit logs, routing decisions, retention/deletion events, KMS-backed signatures) on demand and on schedule. 4) Console UX for managing assertions and exporting evidence. 5) Canary rollout path and compatibility with Dedicated fallbacks.

Out of scope for this ticket: changes to on-prem Private control plane and marketplace contract templates. Those will be tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant API exists to set: assertion_scope (per-route|account), primary_region, routing_mode (strict|preferred|best-effort)
Runtime enforces routing_mode: strict => only local endpoints; preferred => prefer local, fallback documented; best-effort => no hard guarantee but signal included
Retention policy metadata (retention_ttl, retention_class) attached to persisted objects and honored by storage lifecycle jobs
Evidence bundle generation: on-demand export + scheduled weekly snapshot with signed manifest, routing traces, deletion records, and hash of exported objects
Signed attestation format documented and verifiable with public verification key; sample verifier CLI provided in repo
Console panels to view assertions, last evidence export timestamp, and start manual export (RBAC-protected) are visible in staging
Performance impact measured: <5% p95 latency regression for region-aware routing in canary traffic
Automated tests & integration test harness for evidence generation added to ci/compliance-suite
Security review completed and KMS integration validated in staging
